div.b: The same edge in every app

div.span: A CloudFront-scope web ACL with the MCP rule stack from the AWS blog (IP reputation, rate limits per IP, initialize and tool, Bot Control, body size, protocol version, tool allowlist, SSRF, SQLi and XSS in arguments), and a viewer-request CloudFront Function that pre-filters tokens.
